blurb: Guests can book private helicopter charters from Newport Airport to destinations such as Martha's Vineyard, Montauk, Boston Logan Airport, and New York City. Packages also include combined experiences with local attractions like the Newport Car Museum and The Breakers Mansion. Flights range from 20 minutes to 75 minutes depending on the destination.
